class.name: ScenarioEventServer
class.brief_description: RID based registry and queue of the scenario's events - their dispatcher.
class.description: The original's event_manager ([code]Event.h:638[/code]). An event is a delay, an optional condition ([ScenarioEventCondition]) and an action ([ScenarioEventAction]); the server knows no event types - what [code]updatevalues[/code] or [code]lights[/code] means is the business of an action. A queued event runs once its time comes: its condition is tested, then the action's [method ScenarioEventAction._run] or [method ScenarioEventAction._run_else] is called. The time is [SimulationServer]'s simulation time, in seconds, which the physics and the drivers read too. An event may belong to an event system ([method system_create]), whose implementation ([ScenarioEventImplementation]) says what more its events are: which may not be queued, when one runs, what follows its run - and keeps entries of its own in the queue ([method system_schedule]).

method.name: event_attach_action
method.description: Sets what [param event] does when it runs.

method.name: event_attach_condition
method.description: Sets what decides whether [param event] runs its action's [method ScenarioEventAction._run] or [method ScenarioEventAction._run_else]; a null condition always passes.

method.name: event_create
method.description: Creates an event: no delay, no condition, no action.

method.name: event_exists
method.description: Whether the event exists.

method.name: event_free
method.description: Frees [param event]; a queued one is taken off the queue ([signal event_dequeued]).

method.name: event_get_action
method.description: What [param event] does when it runs.

method.name: event_get_condition
method.description: What decides how [param event] runs; null for none.

method.name: event_get_delay
method.description: Seconds [param event] waits from being queued to running.

method.name: event_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param event].

method.name: event_get_random_delay
method.description: Up to this many seconds more [param event] waits, drawn each time it is queued.

method.name: event_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The event of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: event_get_run_time
method.description: The simulation time ([method SimulationServer.simulation_get_time]) a queued [param event] runs at, negative when it is not queued.

method.name: event_get_system
method.description: The event system the event belongs to, none for none.

method.name: event_is_queued
method.description: Whether [param event] waits in the queue.

method.name: event_queue
method.description: Queues [param event] to run after its delay plus [param extra_delay]; [param activator] is the vehicle that queued it. An event is queued once: while it waits, another request is refused and its activator is dropped ([code]event_manager::AddToQuery[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2380-2462[/code]). The implementation of the event's system may refuse it ([method ScenarioEventImplementation._event_can_queue]) and says when it runs ([method ScenarioEventImplementation._event_get_run_time]). Returns whether it was queued.

method.name: event_set_delay
method.description: Seconds [param event] waits from being queued to running.

method.name: event_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param event] is found by ([method event_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: event_set_random_delay
method.description: Up to [param seconds] more [param event] waits, drawn each time it is queued.

method.name: queue_get_events
method.description: Returns the queued events in the order they run.

method.name: system_add_event
method.description: The event belongs to the system from now on.

method.name: system_attach_implementation
method.description: The implementation of the system's events: [method ScenarioEventImplementation._system_detached] of the previous one, [method ScenarioEventImplementation._system_attached] of this one.

method.name: system_create
method.description: An event system, of no implementation yet.

method.name: system_free
method.description: Detaches the system's implementation first; its events stay, of no system.

method.name: system_get_implementation
method.description: The implementation of the system, null for none.

method.name: system_schedule
method.description: The system's implementation is called back ([method ScenarioEventImplementation._scheduled]) for [param owner] at [param time] of simulation time, in the queue's order; returns the entry's ticket, passed back with it.

signal.name: event_dequeued
signal.description: A queued event left the queue without launching - it was freed (its scenery unloaded). The RID is no longer valid.

signal.name: event_freed
signal.description: Emitted when the [param event] is freed ([method event_free]): whoever holds it forgets it.

signal.name: event_launched
signal.description: [param event], queued by [param activator], came to run - before its condition is tested.
